steps.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Generate ONE standalone original source photograph for a public-safe GitHub example, NOT a collage or before/after layout. A fictional adult East Asian woman with short black bob hair, ivory linen shirt, terracotta ankle-length skirt, flat sandals, standing relaxed at a limestone coastal overlook in a Mediterranean-inspired fictional town. Full body, both hands and feet visible. Turquoise sea, curved pale stone balustrade, a small cream house with shuttered window and unlit brass wall lantern to the right. Natural clear daylight, believable editorial travel photography, detailed skin and fabric, no famous person likeness, no logos, no text, no watermark. Landscape 3:2, subject slightly left of center with ample safe margins; keep sea horizon and architectural anchors clear. This is the BEFORE source only; no night panel.

Use case: lighting-weather. Input image is the sole edit target and identity/composition reference. Follow day-night-dual-poster: create a finished portrait 3:4 photographic diptych with two independently closed LANDSCAPE windows stacked vertically, daylight above and night below. Landscape original and sea horizon favor stacked layout over side-by-side, preserving full body and scene width. Repeat the EXACT same woman, face, bob, white shirt, terracotta skirt, hands, feet, pose, camera, subject scale, balustrade, house, shutters, plant, coastline and crop in both. Upper retains source daylight. Lower convincingly reconstructs same scene at night: deep blue sky, cool moonlit sea, existing wall lantern switched on with believable warm spill onto wall and face, tiny distant town lights. Not simply darkening. Premium warm ivory editorial border 5%, thin charcoal keylines, complete hard horizontal separator 1.2%; no text. Nothing crosses divider or panel boundaries; no gradient blend, no body cropping. Entire person and sandals preserved in each window. Image is a genuine transformation from the supplied Before, not a comparison of unrelated people.
